dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hmm, this world seems to operate on different rules. My Tzitzimimeh are unable to unleash their full power.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: So, even if I want to help you, there are some limits on my ability to fight indefinitely.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: You should take a break. Do you need a drink? A pillow, maybe a light novel...? Don't be shy... Really, you're sure you don't want anything? Heh, you're so low-maintenance...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Keep going. Whatever challenges lie ahead, you'll make mincemeat of them.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: At least, that's the fate that your allies have foretold.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: What about me? My role is to be your loyal and dedicated assistant, of course. Why else would I leave the comfort of my home?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Since the fate of the Tzitzimimeh has been obscured, they can't operate at their full strength here. But the good news is, our current proximity to the Ley Lines has enhanced my own abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Just what is this place? It's truly full of mysteries...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Well, I have all the time in the world, so I might as well find a free corner and move all my stuff in. Then I can start trying to figure out what all of this really means...
